posts.text:
Happy Hump Day!!
My grandson says I am an Aries which is the Ram....
I was FIRST in line at the Bank at 8:59 so that tracks LOL
SHARE if you are also a Ram!!
Love, Barb
posts.caption: Aries is the first sign of the zodiac and the Ram likes to be first at everything, including the bank. Ruled by Mars, they hate waiting and love a head start. Are you the first one in line?

posts.text:
Not on Facebook much but my Horoscope in the newspaper said Aries should "slow down and think before acting"
Too late I already bought the Boat....
LOL Gary
posts.caption: Aries runs on Mars energy, which means acting first and reading the instructions later. Their impulsive streak makes life exciting and sometimes very nautical. What's the most Aries purchase you've ever made?

posts.text:
COPY and PASTE if you are an Aries who has honked at a light that turned green 1 second ago!!!
Most people won't....
but my REAL friends will
Debbie
posts.caption: Aries is a cardinal fire sign with zero patience for anything that moves slower than they do, traffic lights included. The impatience comes from a genuine love of momentum. Do you know an Aries who honks first?

posts.text:
Linda this comment was for Carol not you.
Anyway Aries men will ask you to marry them on the 2nd date.
Your Uncle Ron did. Fifty one years now LOL
Mom
posts.caption: Aries falls fast and commits faster, because hesitation just isn't in their chart. That bold, all-in energy can make for a whirlwind romance that actually lasts. Would you say yes on the second date?

posts.text:
I am a Taurus which is the Bull and I would like to say I am NOT stubborn.
I have said this since 1971 and I am not changing it now.
SHARE if you agree!!
LOL Diane
posts.caption: Taurus is a fixed earth sign, which means once they decide something, that decision is basically carved in stone. Their stubbornness is really loyalty to what works. What's a Taurus in your life never budging on?

posts.text:
Happy Friday Eve!!!
Taurus is the sign of comfort and good food...
My husband is a Taurus he has worn the Recliner into the exact shape of himself.
This is so true!!!
Pat
posts.caption: Ruled by Venus, Taurus is all about comfort, routine and the simple pleasures, like one perfect chair. They build a cozy life and settle into it fully. Does your Taurus have a designated seat?

posts.text:
Took a quiz on here that said Taurus loves Luxury.....
I do enjoy the GOOD paper towels
Type YES if you are a Taurus who will not buy the off brand!!
Rhonda
posts.caption: Taurus has a famously refined taste for quality, even in everyday things. Venus gives them an eye for what feels good and lasts. What's the one thing you refuse to buy the cheap version of?

posts.text:
Dating tip for my Granddaughter (Kayleigh please read)
A Taurus man will not text back fast but he WILL show up with a casserole and fix your fence
That is how you know
Love Nana
posts.caption: Taurus shows love through steady actions rather than fast replies. They're dependable, practical and quietly devoted once they're in. Would you take a fixed fence over a quick text?

posts.text:
Gemini is the Twins.....
I do not have a twin but I DO have two Facebooks because I forgot the password to the first one
Please like my NEW page!!
Terri
posts.caption: Gemini is symbolized by the Twins, and they really do seem to live two lives at once. Their curious, restless minds are always starting something new. How many accounts does the Gemini in your life have?

posts.text:
Not on Facebook much but
Gemini people can talk to ANYBODY.
I talked to the man at the Hardware store for 45 minutes about his daughter's wedding. Never got the Mulch
SHARE if this is you LOL
Joyce
posts.caption: Mercury-ruled Gemini can strike up a conversation with literally anyone, anywhere, about anything. The errand is optional; the chat is not. Who's the Gemini that always gets lost in conversation?

posts.text:
Happy Hump Day!! My horoscope in the paper said Geminis "have many interests"
This week: pickleball, sourdough, family tree research, the Ukulele and Italian lessons on my phone
Ciao!!
Sandy
posts.caption: Gemini is a mutable air sign that loves learning a little bit about everything. Their hobbies change as quickly as their interests do, and that's half the fun. What hobby did you pick up this week?

posts.text:
Phil you asked what sign I am. I am Gemini which means I have two sides...
One side wants to go to the Italian place and one wants to stay home
We can do both
LOL Cheryl
posts.caption: Geminis have a split personality reputation because they genuinely want to try every option. Dating one means saying yes to plans that change and evolve. Would you rather go out or stay in with a Gemini?

posts.text:
I am a Cancer which is the Crab and I am a Homebody.
Why go Out when I have my Afghan, my Hallmark movie and 400 photos of the grandkids to look at...
SHARE if you agree!!
Peggy
posts.caption: Cancer is ruled by the Moon and finds its happiest place at home, wrapped in something soft. Like the crab, they carry their comfort zone with them. What's your perfect night in?

posts.text:
My horoscope says Cancers are very emotional....
I cried at a diaper commercial, the Olympics, AND when the waitress remembered my name
This is so true!!!
LOL Marlene
posts.caption: Cancer is a water sign that feels everything deeply, from big moments to tiny kindnesses. Their sensitivity is exactly what makes them such caring partners and friends. What always makes you tear up?

posts.text:
Type AMEN if you are a Cancer who still has every birthday card anyone ever sent you since 1974!!!
Most people will scroll past...
But a Crab never lets go
Judy
posts.caption: Cancer is the zodiac's sentimental keeper, holding onto memories, keepsakes and people for life. That crab grip is pure loyalty. What's the oldest keepsake you still have?

posts.text:
Kevin I told you if you are dating a Cancer you bring her MOTHER flowers too.
They are very close to family
This is how I got your Father
(Kevin please call your mother)
Mom
posts.caption: Family comes first for Cancer, so winning them over usually means winning over their people too. They're nurturing, protective and deeply loyal in love. Have you ever had to impress the whole family?

posts.text:
I am a Leo which is the Lion.....
That is why I have the big hair
Ruled by the SUN!!
Please like my page, I posted 41 photos from the cruise
Love, Donna
posts.caption: Leo is ruled by the Sun and loves to shine, ideally from multiple angles in a full photo album. Their confidence and flair are part of their warmth. How many vacation photos is too many for a Leo?

posts.text:
Happy Hump Day to everyone EXCEPT the people who did not wish me happy birthday in August
Just kidding I love you all
A Leo never forgets LOL
Sharon
posts.caption: Leos treat their birthday like a national holiday and they absolutely notice who showed up. Underneath the drama is a big, generous heart that wants to celebrate everyone. Did you remember your Leo's birthday?

posts.text:
Leos are VERY generous.
I paid for the whole table at the seafood restaurant and only mentioned it for 3 weeks
This is so true!!! SHARE
Rick
posts.caption: Leo is one of the most generous signs in the zodiac and loves treating the people they care about. A little applause afterward never hurts either. Has a Leo ever picked up the whole check for you?

posts.text:
Brenda I saw your new boyfriend is a Leo.
He will need lots of compliments...
Tell him his Truck is nice
This is how Leos stay happy
LOL Aunt Kathy
posts.caption: Leos thrive on appreciation, and a sincere compliment goes a very long way with them. Give them admiration and they'll give you loyalty and warmth in return. What's your go-to compliment for a Leo?

posts.text:
I am a Virgo which is the Lady holding the Wheat....
I have reorganized the Tupperware drawer 3 times today and the lids STILL don't match
SHARE if you're a Virgo!!
Elaine
posts.caption: Virgo is the zodiac's organizer, a Mercury-ruled earth sign that finds peace in putting things in order. Mismatched lids are their natural enemy. What drawer would a Virgo fix first in your house?

posts.text:
Not on Facebook much but I found 4 spelling mistakes in the neighborhood Newsletter and my horoscope said Virgos "notice details others miss"
I have circled them in red pen
This is so true!!!
Bev
posts.caption: Virgos have an eye for detail that catches what everyone else skims past. It comes from a genuine desire to make things better. Have you ever been corrected by a Virgo?

posts.text:
Virgos are very Helpful...
I helped my son load the dishwasher. Then I re-loaded it the right way.
He's welcome!!
Type YES if you are a Virgo
LOL Mom
posts.caption: Helping is a Virgo's love language, even when the help involves quietly redoing your work. They just want everything done right. Does someone in your house reload the dishwasher after you?

posts.text:
Dating a Virgo??
He will make a list about you
Your Uncle Don did this in 1978 on actual paper
It had pros and cons and I had more pros
SHARE this to a Virgo!!
Auntie Lou
posts.caption: Virgos approach love thoughtfully and analytically, weighing every detail before they commit. Once you make the list, you're in for good. Would you want to see a Virgo's pros and cons list about you?

posts.text:
I am a Libra which is the Scale. Not the bathroom kind LOL!!!
We like everything Fair and Balanced...
I cut the pie into 8 EXACT pieces and still nobody was happy
Carol
posts.caption: Libra is symbolized by the Scales and craves fairness and harmony in every situation, dessert included. They work hard to keep everyone happy. Who's the Libra in your family who cuts the pie?

posts.text:
Libras can not make decisions.
We have been at the restaurant 40 min. The waitress has come by 5 times. I am thinking about the soup OR the salad
SHARE if you agree.... or don't, either is fine
Nancy
posts.caption: Libras see every side of every option, which makes choosing anything a real event. Their indecision comes from wanting the best possible outcome. How long does it take your Libra to order?

posts.text:
Happy Hump Day!! My horoscope in the Newspaper says Libras love Romance and Pretty things...
My husband got me a Card with a lighthouse on it
Very nice I will put it on the fridge
LOL Gail
posts.caption: Venus-ruled Libra is a true romantic with a love for beauty and thoughtful gestures. Even a simple card can feel like a love letter to them. What's the sweetest small gesture you've received?

posts.text:
Libras hate an argument...
I have agreed with BOTH my sisters about the Thanksgiving thing
Please do not tell either one
Delete this if you are Darlene
Love Connie
posts.caption: Libra is the zodiac's peacekeeper, and they'll go to great lengths to avoid taking sides. Keeping harmony matters more to them than being right. Do you know a Libra who agrees with everyone?

posts.text:
I am a Scorpion which is the most Mysterious sign...
My grandson says it's "Scorpio" but I like Scorpion better it is scarier
Do NOT cross me at Bingo
LOL Marge
posts.caption: Scorpio is a fixed water sign known for intensity, mystery and a competitive streak that runs deep. They play to win, even at bingo. Who's the most intense Scorpio you know?

posts.text:
Not on Facebook much but I see EVERYTHING.
I saw you un-liked my post Tammy.
A Scorpio always knows....
Happy Hump Day!!
Ruth
posts.caption: Scorpios are famously observant and notice the smallest shifts in how people act. Very little gets past them, online or off. Has a Scorpio ever caught something you thought nobody saw?

posts.text:
WARNING to all Scorpios:
Copy and Paste this in the next 10 min or your Secrets will be revealed!!!
Just kidding a Scorpio would never tell you their secrets
Most of my friends won't even share this
Deb
posts.caption: Scorpio is ruled by Pluto and guards its private life closely, sharing secrets only with people who've earned it. That privacy is part of their magnetic mystery. What's one thing a Scorpio has never told you?

posts.text:
Darryl please read
If you are dating a Scorpio do NOT fib about where you were.
She already knows.
She is just waiting to see if you will tell her
This is so true!!!
Aunt Patty
posts.caption: Scorpios value honesty and loyalty above almost anything in a relationship, and their intuition is sharp. Being upfront is the fastest way to earn their trust. Would you ever try to keep a secret from a Scorpio?

posts.text:
I am a Sagittarian which is the Archer.....
Or the half Horse man? Either way I LOVE to travel!!
Here are 212 pictures from Branson
Please like my page!!
Love, Rita
posts.caption: Sagittarius is the zodiac's traveler, a fire sign ruled by Jupiter that is always planning the next adventure. Their symbol is the centaur archer, aiming for somewhere new. Where's your next trip?

posts.text:
Sagittarius people say what they think!!
I told my neighbor her potato salad needed salt
She agreed!!
Honesty is the best policy
SHARE if you're Blunt
LOL Vern
posts.caption: Sagittarians are famously honest, sometimes a little too honest, but always with good intentions. They believe the truth is a kindness. Has a Sagittarius ever given you a review you didn't ask for?

posts.text:
My Horoscope in the newspaper says Sagittarius needs FREEDOM
That is why we bought the RV
We are in New Mexico I think...
Happy Hump Day or whatever day it is!!
Don and Sheila
posts.caption: Freedom is a Sagittarius essential, and they're happiest when the road ahead is wide open. Plans are loose and the vibes are optimistic. Would you hop in the RV with a Sagittarius?

posts.text:
Jen you said this new fella is a Sagittarius.
He will not want to settle down until he has seen every National Park
Get comfy walking shoes honey
This is so true!!!
Grandma
posts.caption: Sagittarius brings adventure into relationships and wants a partner who'll explore alongside them. Keep up and you'll have the best stories of anyone you know. Are you ready for a Sagittarius road trip?

posts.text:
I am a Capricorn which is the Goat.
I worked at the same company 38 years and never once missed a Monday
SHARE if you are a hard working Goat!!
Dale
posts.caption: Capricorn is the zodiac's hardest worker, a Saturn-ruled earth sign built for long-term commitment and steady climbing. Like the mountain goat, they keep going until they reach the top. Who's the most dedicated Capricorn you know?

posts.text:
Capricorns are very good with Money.
I still have the twist tie from the bread in 1996
You never know!!
Type YES if you agree
LOL Phyllis
posts.caption: Capricorns are practical planners who believe in saving for later, whatever later might bring. Their thriftiness is how they build security. What's the most Capricorn thing you've ever saved?

posts.text:
Not on Facebook much but my Horoscope said Capricorns "seem serious but have a dry sense of humor"
I do not know what they mean by that
(That was the joke)
Bob
posts.caption: Capricorns often come across as serious, but they hide one of the driest, sharpest senses of humor in the zodiac. You just have to listen closely. Did you get the joke on the first read?

posts.text:
Dating advice from your Grandpa (a Capricorn):
Bring a 5 year plan to the first date
I brought mine on a legal pad in 1969
Your Grandma said yes on the 3rd date
Plan worked
Love Grandpa Walt
posts.caption: Capricorns date with the future in mind and like to know where things are headed. That reliability makes them steady, committed partners. Would you be charmed or nervous if a date brought a five-year plan?

posts.text:
I am an Aquarius which is the Water sign!!!
(my grandson says it's actually an AIR sign??? But it's got Water in the name...)
Anyway I'm very Unique
SHARE if you are one of a kind
LOL Janet
posts.caption: Aquarius is the Water Bearer but actually an air sign, which is fitting for the zodiac's most delightfully unconventional sign. They love being one of a kind. Did you know Aquarius was an air sign?

posts.text:
Aquarius people are ahead of their time....
I had a Cell phone in 1994. It was the size of a Brick and lived in the car
This is so true!!!
Happy Hump Day
Glenn
posts.caption: Ruled by Uranus, Aquarius loves innovation and is usually first to try the newest thing. They're the early adopters of the zodiac. What gadget did your Aquarius buy before anyone else?

posts.text:
Aquarius likes to help the WHOLE World but needs alone time also.
I organized the neighborhood food drive and then did not answer the door for 2 days
SHARE if you agree!!
Lorraine
posts.caption: Aquarius is a humanitarian at heart, but they also need plenty of space to recharge. Big community energy, then a quiet retreat. Do you know an Aquarius who disappears after a good deed?

posts.text:
Cindy this is for the Aquarius man you are seeing...
He will say "I just need my Space"
Do not worry. He will come back with a Very interesting fact about Octopuses
Love you
Mom
posts.caption: Aquarians value independence in love and need room to think their own thoughts. Give them space and they'll return with fascinating ideas to share. What's the best random fact an Aquarius has told you?

posts.text:
I am a Pisces which is the Fish...
Two Fish actually, swimming in different directions
That is why I walked in the kitchen and started daydreaming
Happy Hump Day!!
LOL Lorna
posts.caption: Pisces is symbolized by two fish swimming in opposite directions, a perfect picture of their dreamy, drifting mind. They're always half here and half somewhere lovely. Where does your mind wander?

posts.text:
Pisces are very sensitive....
I cried at a Minion movie. TWICE.
Don't judge me, they were trying their best
SHARE if you are a Fish with a big heart!!
Tina
posts.caption: Pisces is the zodiac's most empathetic sign and feels for everyone, even small yellow cartoon characters. Their big heart is their superpower. What movie always gets you?

posts.text:
My Horoscope in the Newspaper says Pisces are "Dreamers and Romantics"
I have been planning my dream trip to Italy since 1982
I have the brochure right here
Type YES if you are a Dreamer
Bonnie
posts.caption: Neptune-ruled Pisces lives for big dreams and romantic visions of the future. They may take the scenic route, but they never stop believing. What dream trip have you been planning forever?

posts.text:
Pisces will fall in love with anybody who is nice to them for 5 min
The mailman waved at me and I have already picked out our Song
This is so true!!!
LOL Darla
posts.caption: Pisces are hopeless romantics who fall fast and imagine the whole love story right away. Their open hearts make them some of the most devoted partners in the zodiac. Have you ever picked a song after one wave?
